rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bug, test, fix, diff, agent, root cause, and PR are named in the lede or prior chunks; optional prompt references resolve as exercise session artifacts.
No body callback points to another file or page by position; the prework bug is named as a session artifact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No fixed module-beat callback is made; references are to the student's live bug, test, diff, and PR.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The exercise requests a test-fail/fix-pass sequence but does not narrate an outcome before a guess instruction.
Each chunk contains a concrete action or generalisation; the optional deeper-layer chunk still states the decision it asks the student to make.
The five headings accurately summarize test-first work, diff reading, deeper interrogation, continued plausibility, and shipping.
All six sub-items checked. The bold callout is the source-attested task-sizing handle, and no banned cadence, self-grading, retraction, abstraction stack, or empty triplet is present.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No compendium/firing/forcing-function/beat/mood/surface dialect appears; root cause, test, diff, and PR are engineer register.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1's short bold handle and task-sizing callout are permitted handles/mandated exercise sizing; no whole narrative bullet is bolded.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Shared exercise is inlined as phase--exercise; layout suite passed 24/24.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No Phase/Step headings or references; per-file numbering check exited 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Action headings carry the exercise; 'There is always a next plausible answer' is the earned declarative generalisation at the right moment.
